title: classmethod vs staticmethod
summary: Instance, class and static methods: what each receives, factories that respect subclasses through cls, and when a plain function is better.

clips.title: Three kinds of method
clips.question: Instance, class, or static method: what does each receive, and when do you use it?

scenes.say: Methods, question one. Instance method, class method, or static method: what does each one receive, and when do you use it? Pause and answer out loud.

An instance method receives the instance, self, and works on its state. A class method receives the class itself, cls, so it can read class state, and build new instances: the classic alternative constructor. A static method receives nothing extra: it's a plain function, namespaced in the class because it belongs there logically.

items.body: A plain function in the class namespace.

scenes.say: Here, from birth year is a class method. It computes the age, and calls cls, not Person, to build the object. Is adult is a static method: a small utility that needs neither the instance nor the class. And because the factory uses cls, calling it on the Student subclass returns a Student.

clips.title: The subclass trap
clips.question: Why should a factory be a classmethod rather than a staticmethod?

scenes.say: Question two. Why should a factory method be a class method, rather than a static method that calls the class by name? Pause and answer out loud.

props.question: Why a classmethod factory, not a static one?

scenes.say: A static factory has to name the class it builds, so it hardcodes Person. Call it on Student, and you still get a Person back: the subclass is silently lost. A class method receives whichever class it was called on, so cls of name builds a Student when called on Student. Same code, correct type.

left.label: @staticmethod
left.title: Returns a Person

right.label: @classmethod
right.title: Returns a Student

verdict.text: Factories take cls, so subclasses get their own type.

scenes.say: To recap. Instance methods take self, and work on the object. Class methods take cls: use them for alternative constructors, and they respect subclasses. Static methods take nothing: utilities that belong with the class. And if a function needs neither, a module-level function is often cleaner still.

items.text: Instance methods take self: object state.
Needs neither? A module function may be cleaner.
